description: A sunlit outdoor terrace photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing a white stucco exterior wall beside a black-framed steel-and-glass French door in a three-quarter corner composition. Below it, two matching deep-seat outdoor lounge chairs in woven black rope over a dark powder-coated frame are paired with matching ottoman footrests, all cushioned in thick cream linen. A large mature weeping willow tree spills its trailing branches from beyond the garden wall on the right, creating a romantic green canopy. Low ornamental shrubs and architectural grasses fill the garden bed along the base of the terrace wall. A large stone boulder adds natural texture in the right corner. The mood is warm, Mediterranean-coastal, and relaxed.
